panel.heading: Backup & Restore
panel.description: Save your destinations, overlays, alerts, templates, and other configuration to a file, or restore a previous one.

export.heading: Create a backup
export.body: Downloads a single file with your configuration. Safe to keep or move to another computer.
export.error: The backup could not be created.

includes.title: Included
includes.accounts: Connected account list (reconnecting is required after a restore)
includes.visual: Visual templates, designs, and their images/sounds
includes.donationSources: Donation source list (re-entering the credential is required after a restore)

excludes.title: Never included
excludes.remoteManagement: Remote-management, remote-ingest, and remote-overlay security material
excludes.engagementContent: Chat messages, chatter names, donation messages, or any other viewer content

restore.heading: Restore from a backup
restore.body: Replaces your entire current configuration with the one from a backup file. This cannot be undone from within the app - a safety copy of your current configuration is kept, but only the single most recent one.
restore.chooseFileLabel: Choose a backup file to restore

preview.title: Review before restoring
preview.attentionAccounts_one: {{count}} connected account will need to be reconnected
preview.attentionAccounts_other: {{count}} connected accounts will need to be reconnected
preview.attentionKeys_one: {{count}} destination will need its stream key re-entered
preview.attentionKeys_other: {{count}} destinations will need their stream keys re-entered
preview.attentionDonations_one: {{count}} donation source will need its credential re-entered
preview.attentionDonations_other: {{count}} donation sources will need their credentials re-entered
preview.error: This file could not be read as a backup.

confirm.title: Restore this backup?
confirm.message: Your entire current configuration will be replaced with the one from this backup. Streaming keys, OAuth connections, and donation-source credentials are never included, so those will need to be reconnected afterward. Streaming Tree will need to restart to finish applying it.
confirm.error: The restore could not be completed. Your existing configuration was not changed.

streamingActive.message: Streaming is active. Stop streaming before restoring a backup.

restartNotice.title: Restart required
restartNotice.body: The backup was restored. Streaming Tree needs to restart before the restored configuration fully takes effect.
restartNotice.quitConfirmMessage: This stops the application completely. Start it again afterward to finish applying the restored configuration.
restartNotice.stopped: Streaming Tree has stopped. Start it again to finish applying the restored configuration.
